visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses, a brown jacket, and a backpack stands against a white wall, speaking with an expressive facial expression. (2) A man wearing a white lab coat, a grey wig, and a fake mustache (Doctor persona) stands in a brightly lit room, holding a clipboard and gesturing. (3) Two red and white ceramic Pokeball-shaped jars are positioned on a sleek white cabinet top against a plain background. (4) The man in the brown jacket leans in close to the jars, points at one, and then picks it up, showing a look of surprise. (5) The man stands outdoors in front of a grey brick wall, holding the red Pokeball jar; he approaches another young man wearing a blue-striped shirt and a black baseball cap who is leaning against the wall looking at a phone. (6) The man opens the jar, and a bright white light effect glows from within; it is revealed to be a bowl of soup with various ingredients. (7) A close-up shot shows a white bowl filled with dark soup, mushrooms, and meat; text overlays list the ingredients over the food. (8) Two men sit on a tan leather couch in a living room, eating from the Pokeball jars and Pikachu-themed bowls on a wooden table. (9) A close-up of a smartphone screen shows a text message appearing in a blue bubble, then the man with glasses looks back at the phone with a concerned expression. (10) Multiple shots show the men eating the soup with wooden chopsticks, smiling and talking; final shots show Pikachu and Snorlax graphics at the bottom of the empty white bowls.
